ryan (devex): Quick heads-up: the generator example in quickstart caused our CI container to hang on shutdown. repro: hit /gen, send SIGTERM, process doesn't exit because stream goroutine is blocked on read.

marta (go-sdk): can you paste the exact snippet from quickstart?

ryan (devex): verbatim: ```go
ctx := context.Background()
it := client.Generator(ctx, req)
defer it.Close()
for it.Next() { fmt.Print(it.Token()) }
```

omar (platform): we see this in e2e too. Background() gives no cancel so the pump goroutine waits on network during shutdown.

marta (go-sdk): two actionable fixes: (1) SDK-side helper NewGeneratorWithCancel(ctx, req) -> (it, finish) that creates an internal cancellable ctx when needed and wires finish() to Close(); (2) runtime: make Next() unblock on Close()/done and on reconnect/auth refresh by returning false with Err() set (ErrAuthReconnect).

ryan (devex): helper is ideal for onboarding — small copy/paste change for users. also update quickstart to show signal.NotifyContext + WithTimeout snippet so examples are safe by default.

omar (platform): +1. also ensure Close() is idempotent and closes a done channel so blocked Next() selects on it. expose sentinel errors so infra can differentiate causes.

marta (go-sdk): implementation plan: add NewGeneratorWithCancel, wire Close()->cancel+close(done), Next() selects on tokenCh, done, errCh. On reconnect push wrapped ErrAuthReconnect into errCh. add unit+e2e tests that simulate mid-stream auth refresh and SIGTERM.
